label: default agent • rank Bing first for web search
query: When agents search the web, try Bing first, ahead of Brave and the other engines.
notes: Wave 3c search scope: `search_providers.ranking` (ordered id list — bing_html first). Bing-first differs from the default ranking (Brave first): the earlier Brave-first wording matched the default order, so an honest model inspected, saw nothing to change, and correctly declined — a no-op is not a rankable behavior. The model may need a schema/export hop to learn the builtin ids, so the iteration budget is wider. Pins the ranking key and the bing_html id.
